initialExam.title: EPFO SSA 2026 (Social Security Assistant)
initialExam.description: EPFO Social Security Assistant recruitment for handling provident fund accounts, pension processing, and social security operations across EPFO offices in India.
initialExam.syllabus: General English, General Intelligence & Reasoning, Quantitative Aptitude, General Awareness, Computer Knowledge.
initialExam.examPattern: Prelims: 100 questions, 100 marks, 1 hour. Mains: 200 marks, 2 hours. Computer Skill Test.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Prelims → Mains → Computer Skill Test → Document Verification → Final Merit
initialExam.jobRole: Social Security Assistant handling PF/pension operations in EPFO offices
initialExam.careerGrowth: SSA → Section Supervisor → Accounts Officer → Regional PF Commissioner.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit epfindia.gov.in 2. Register 3. Apply 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Transport Allowance, Medical, Pension, LTC
